transcript: My pregnant wife asked me to put her bag by the door, but I did this instead. There you are. Where's all the bags? What? I just packed them all. What? I was gonna help you. Well, I got them all in there and now I have a surprise for you. What? Another surprise? And here's your passenger princess zone. What do you think? That's so perfect. You like it? Yeah. I got your blanket. the switch, your water, snack bag. I like my snacks. I know you do. Sweetie, you did too much. No, I didn't. Yes, I was gonna drive some. You're not driving, you're pregnant. The steering wheel is too close to the belly. No. You're gonna put this blanket on, you're gonna put the chair back, and you're gonna sleep some because I know you were rolling around last night not sleeping. I'm so tired. Okay, so let's take another hour or two of sleep and then when you wake up we'll have breakfast okay I love you excited for a trip You are? Okay. We love road trips. Well, go ahead and take a little nap, okay? Okay.
metadata_caption: Backstory ::: Kay and I are packing up for a 10 hour drive to Alabama for the baby shower! 🎉 This is our first long drive since she got pregnant, so we aren’t sure how kay will do, but we hope she isn’t too sore from the ride. Kay hasn’t been sleeping well at night because of her restless leg and heartburn. So when she asked me to put the bags by the door so she could have a few extra minutes of sleep, I decided that I would not only load the whole car, but I would also get everything that she would need to be the passenger princess for our journey! She has been putting up with so many pregnancy related issues, so she deserves to get some extra nap time while I drive! 😁❤️ #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant
